description: Defines scheduler configuration structures, classes, and interfaces for managing UEs and cells in a 5G NR scheduler, including configuration requests, reconfiguration, creation, deletion, and notifications.

classes.name: scheduler_configurator
classes.description: Interface for managing addition, removal, and configuration of cells and UEs.

classes.name: scheduler_ue_configurator
classes.description: Interface for handling UE creation, reconfiguration, removal, and status updates.

classes.name: sched_configuration_notifier
classes.description: Interface for notifying completion of UE configuration and deletion.

methods.name: handle_cell_configuration_request
methods.description: Reconfigure a cell with specified parameters.

methods.name: handle_cell_removal_request
methods.description: Remove a cell from the scheduler.

methods.name: handle_ue_creation_request
methods.description: Create a new UE in the scheduler.

methods.name: handle_ue_removal_request
methods.description: Remove a UE from the scheduler.

methods.name: handle_ue_config_applied
methods.description: Notify that UE configuration has been applied.

methods.name: on_ue_config_complete
methods.description: Notify that UE creation/modification is complete.

methods.name: on_ue_deletion_completed
methods.description: Notify that UE deletion is complete.
